What to arrange before a dataset is submitted. The submission itself follows
the [Submission manual](index.qmd).

## Access

Submitting requires access to the private BigPicture repositories and container
images. Request it via the [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}}).

## Test in staging

BigPicture has two environments: staging for testing, and production for the
archive. Submit a test dataset with a small number of slides to staging first.
Staging is not set up for sensitive personal data.
See [Best Practices](bp-submission-pipeline/best-practices.qmd#do-a-staging-run-first).

## Production

Uploading to production requires signed Terms of Use and separate production
credentials. See [Prepare for production](bp-submission-pipeline/prepare-for-production.qmd).

## Contact

- **Data submission:** [bp-ops](mailto:{{< var email.bpops >}})
- **Support:** [servicedesk](mailto:{{< var email.helpdesk >}})
